edges.reason: Constructor mints the whole supply to _msgSender derived from msg.sender.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender argument of _transfer.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() for allowance deduction and allowance lookup.
approve stores allowance for the caller via _msgSender().
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender(), so msg.sender decides access.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which reads msg.sender.
renounceOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which reads msg.sender.
setFeeTotal is onlyOwner and mints to _msgSender's balance.
Caller identity must satisfy onlyOwner before setBlackListBot executes.
Caller identity must satisfy onlyOwner before setBlackAddress executes.
Caller identity must satisfy onlyOwner before setMaxTxBlack executes.
blackListAddress is written directly into _tBotAddress.
blackAddress is written directly into _tBlackAddress.
amount flows into _tTotal.add and _balances.add inside setFeeTotal.
maxTxBlackPercent flows into _maxBlack computation.
sender is passed into _transfer from transferFrom.
recipient is passed into _transfer from transferFrom.
amount is used for the transfer and allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
recipient is forwarded to _transfer from transfer.
amount is forwarded to _transfer from transfer.
sender selects the debit side of _balances in _transfer.
recipient selects the credit side of _balances in _transfer.
amount is used in the subtractions and additions of _transfer.
spender becomes the allowance key in approve.
amount becomes the stored allowance value in approve.
owner is the first allowance mapping key in _approve.
spender is the second allowance mapping key in _approve.
amount is stored in _allowances by _approve.
newOwner is checked against zero and stored into _owner.
recipient receives the balance via the low-level call in sendValue.
target is the call target validated by isContract in _functionCallWithValue.
data is forwarded as calldata in _functionCallWithValue.
weiValue is forwarded as msg.value in _functionCallWithValue.
errorMessage is used for the revert when the low-level call fails.
Constructor initializes _balances[_msgSender()] with _tTotal.
_transfer mutates _balances for sender and recipient.
_transfer checks the recipient against _tBotAddress to enforce the cap.
_transfer checks the sender against _tBlackAddress to skip the cap.
_transfer compares amount with the _maxBlack threshold.
transferFrom reads and reduces _allowances before calling _approve.
approve writes the caller allowance into _allowances via _approve.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender].
setBlackListBot writes _tBotAddress.
setBlackAddress writes _tBlackAddress.
setFeeTotal adds amount to _tTotal, changing total supply.
setFeeTotal credits _balances[_msgSender()] with the minted amount.
setMaxTxBlack computes maxTxBlackPercent * 10**18 without overflow protection.
transferOwnership assigns newOwner to _owner.
renounceOwnership emits ownership removal based on _owner.
onlyOwner reads _owner to authorize the caller.
transfer invokes the internal _transfer.
transferFrom invokes the internal _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
onlyOwner modifier guards setBlackListBot.
onlyOwner modifier guards setBlackAddress.
onlyOwner modifier guards the setFeeTotal mint.
onlyOwner modifier guards setMaxTxBlack.
onlyOwner modifier guards transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier guards renounceOwnership.
sendValue executes the low-level call with all available gas, handing control to recipient before returning.
The recipient of the low-level call can re-enter the contract as msg.sender before sendValue completes.
